author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Fighting and government movement restrictions have cut off aid to Akobo, where a UN helicopter can land only briefly. 

The town’s hospital is inundated with gunshot victims; infections make amputations common and staff report shortages of surgical supplies, with CARE International ready to resume support. 

Al Jazeera’s Malcolm Webb reports from Akobo, South Sudan.

Al Jazeera’s Shihab Rattansi reports from the White House.
